title: Great For Small Rooms
text: Great For Small Rooms. This end table is great for small rooms. It's narrow and doesn't take up a lot of space, but it provides you with a place to leave your drink or phone as well as storage below. It was quick and easy to put it together. It's sturdy and it looks good, too!

product_metadata.title: Small Side Table for Small Spaces - Dulcii Slim End Table with Magazine Holder - 22 Inch Narrow End Tables Living Room - Skinny Bedside Table Small Nightstand Bedroom-Industrial Rustic Thin Side Table
features: 【ELEGANT ​APPERRANCE】The frame made of black steel meets engineered-wood material in rustic style. Add a good book and snacks to this side table alongside a cosy couch, the end table will be a decorative accent to your home and perfect combination with other furniture.

【HIGH QUALITY】The tabletop is made of high-quality retro-style MDF board, the metal frame of the coffee table is made of high-density steel, and the textured black metal surface is used high-temperature electroplating technology. Our small side table is the perfect accessory for sofas, armchairs, beds or RV and will fit perfectly well in any nook or corner of your room. Round Corner Tabletop is safe for your daily use.

【SPACE SAVING】This side end table with magazine rack measures 20"(L)*9"(W)*22"(H), with compact construction, this retro industrial accent table is perfect for small living room spaces as a sofa end table or nightstand, the Dulcii side table is narrow but still has space to add a lamp, drink and more while storing magazines in the holder featured below

【VINTAGE DESIGN】Modern industrial side table that is sleek in its design. It has a durable wood board finish on top and a black metal powder-coated frame with a durable oxford fabric magazine sling on the middle, and with a sturdy mesh shelve, which you can attach magazines, books, or a variety of other items

【EASY ASSEMBLY】Easy 10-minute assembly. Including easily picture comprehensible instructions and simple structure of the side tables, all you need is to swing the Allen key(included) according to instructions step by step
